notes.title: Underground Blossom is Now 44% OFF | More updates from The Lake
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/0fde4d536e93153a464c15727bcfc02b6c910ee0.png[/img]

Hey everyone! All our premium games, including Underground Blossom, are now on sale in the Steam Summer Sale for 44% OFF! And to make the summer sale even better, our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3669/Rusty_Lake_Bundle/]Rusty Lake Bundle[/url] is 52% OFF!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291850/Underground_Blossom/

And with the sale, we bring forth some insights into our plans at Rusty Lake:

[h3]Physical Escape Room[/h3]

Lately, we have been very busy with our first physical escape room: Rusty Lake’s Black Cube Exhibition which went live during TwitchCon Rotterdam. The experience turned out to be a huge success, so we hope to bring it to other future conventions, if possible.  Read more on our [url=https://blog.rustylake.com/our-first-physical-went-live-at-twitchcon/]blog[/url]!

[h3]Rusty Lake Untold[/h3]

For the past 2 years, we’ve also been working on our first pen & paper, tabletop, escape room: Rusty Lake Untold. We are thrilled to release our first adventure: The Lab for free later this month: on July 24! Make sure to sign up [url=https://www.rustylakeuntold.com/]here[/url] and read how to play.

[h3]Follow the meaning[/h3]

We are also collaborating with Hiking Mind studio to release their debut title Follow the meaning through our publishing platform: Second Maze. The game is a premium point-and-click adventure with beautiful graphics and playtime of around 1.5 hours. They aim to release in Q3 and we think a lot of people who enjoy Rusty Lake will also enjoy this adventure so make sure to wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720280/Follow_the_meaning/  

Of course, we are also working on new game projects, but unfortunately, we cannot share anything about those plans just yet!

Stay tuned!

PS. All our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/secondmaze]Second Maze games[/url] are also 44% OFF in the Steam Summer Sale!

notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=suz-ceQJ3-A;full][/previewyoutube]

Underground Blossom is OUT NOW! 🚇🌸

Do you have a ticket ready? 🎟️ It’s time to catch the train to Underground Blossom:
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291850/Underground_Blossom/   

The game is also available on iOS, Android, GOG and itchio!

But before you rush off to board the metro and embark on the latest Rusty Lake adventure, we hope you’ll take some time to read a few words of thanks from The Lake!

Developing this game has been quite a journey. As you might have read in our first #[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2291850/view/3668800006272908761]UBDevlog[/url], the game has been in the works for a few years. We laid the ground base for the structure and story two years ago and from there we switched gears by working on The Past Within. At the start of this year, we could finally put the focus back on Underground Blossom. Being able to share a demo during our 8-year anniversary marked an amazing milestone for us and the project. The support and encouragement gave us all the energy we needed to go full steam ahead towards a 2023 release, which is today, September 27. 

Although the new release feels quite soon after shipping [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/]The Past Within[/url], we are so happy to share this beautiful experience with you all. As mentioned before, Underground Blossom feels like a train ride back to our own roots at Rusty Lake. (Quite literally, because this game has many ties with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/532110/Rusty_Lake_Roots/]Roots[/url]). As you travel from station to station and experience various events in Laura’s life, we hope you will enjoy all the small details we put in there for you. So make sure to take your time, and don’t rush on your quest for the next train! 

We really hope you’ll enjoy the game as for us, Underground Blossom has already become one of our favourite games to date. We think the whole journey together with its accompanying music and sound is unmatched in the Rusty Lake universe. And we hope you feel the same!

A big thank you to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/glitchkraft]GlitchKraft[/url] for their awesome gameplay recording of the first 3 stations in Underground Blossom! You can watch the playthrough on our Steam page for the whole first week of release!

Last but not least, we’d like to thank everyone who helped us pave the tracks for this incredible metro journey! 🙏 The soundtrack, sound design, voice acting, QA, translation and localisation, and all of you, our patient passengers, made this project truly special! Thank you so much! 🖤

The Day of The Lake is coming,

Team Rusty Lake

Ps. Don’t forget to make your metro conductor happy by leaving a review of your experience with the Rusty Lake underground! 🙏🖤

notes.title: Underground Blossom – Devlog 3 – Q&A with Rusty Lake
notes.notes:
[h1]Q&A with Rusty Lake[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/afa68cdc097d7474e228fda4b04a409e915f5710.png[/img]
[url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F6-LVVsXAAAS_M4?format=jpg&name=large][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F6-LVVsXAAAS_M4?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url][url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F6-LVVtXYAAc62x?format=jpg&name=large][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F6-LVVtXYAAc62x?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url][url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F6-LVVvWsAA0B8a?format=jpg&name=large][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F6-LVVvWsAA0B8a?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url]

Thanks again for taking the time to send us so many awesome questions. This time we decided to stick mostly to Underground Blossom related questions but worry not, we will host more general Q&As in the future.

First, a little introduction in case you are new to The Lake:

[h2]About Rusty Lake[/h2]

Rusty Lake is an indie game studio based in Amsterdam, founded by Robin Ras & Maarten Looise. Since 2015, we have developed 16 surrealistic point-and-click adventure games in the Rusty Lake Universe. The story of all these games are intertwined and every instalment reveals more about the Rusty Lake mysteries.

We have released the following games on PC and mobile: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/]Cube Escape Collection[/url] (bundle of our 9 Cube Escape episodes), [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/909080/Cube_Escape_Paradox/]Cube Escape: Paradox[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1281800/Samsara_Room/]Samsara Room[/url] and four premium games: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/435120/Rusty_Lake_Hotel/]Rusty Lake Hotel[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/532110/Rusty_Lake_Roots/]Rusty Lake: Roots[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/744190/Rusty_Lake_Paradise/]Rusty Lake Paradise[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145960/The_White_Door/]The White Door[/url]. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/?]The Past Within[/url], our first co-op experience, was released last year and tomorrow, on September 27th, we will release Underground Blossom.

[h2]A community interview:[/h2]

[b]@malthunos: How did you get the idea to develop Laura’s story in a subway? 🚇[/b]

When we brainstorm about new Rusty Lake games, we often start by thinking about interesting locations. A subway or metro station was in our heads for a long time. Eventually, we enjoyed the idea that a metro stop could symbolise a new chapter in someone’s life. Sharing more about Laura Vanderboom’s (secret) life turned out to be the perfect fit for this location for a game, we only had to wait for the right moment.

[b]@onaiashraf: How long will the game be? 🕰️[/b]

Over the past 3 months, we held as many playtests as possible. Some sessions took over 3 hours, while others were much quicker and finished the game within 1.5 hours. Therefore we estimate a normal playthrough of Underground Blossom at 2 hours. But your journey doesn’t simply end after the final station…

[b]Creen Greeper: How many stations will it be? 🚉[/b]

Underground Blossom will have seven [i]standard[/i] stations.

[b]@amiito23_’s: How important is music or the theme going to be to Underground Blossom…? 🌸[/b]

As we mentioned in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2291850/view/3728473875988410914]Devlog 2[/url] last week, music and sound have been among the most important parts of this game. The piano and cello worked so well to enhance the (emotional) journey of Laura. We cannot thank all our musicians enough for their incredible work, Victor, Sebastiaan, Remco and, of course, our sound designers, Jorick and Giliam, did a tremendous job of getting the perfect metro atmosphere for the game. 

[b]@r_no_registrada’s: Do I need the other games to discover the secrets of UB? 🦉[/b]

Most secrets in Underground Blossom can be found without prior knowledge of our other games. But we do recommend to have at least played the Cube Escape Collection (free on mobile). As always, all our games are connected in one way or another and Underground Blossom won’t be any different. So only our die-hard fans can collect the 34 achievements without hints/a walkthrough!

[b]@nowhere: Will you keep the secret ARG level from UB Lite in the full version? It was so enlightening! 📼[/b]

Yes, you can still reach the [url=https://www.bestkeptmemory.com]Best Kept Memory[/url] station in the full game 🙂

[b]@gracie._.smiles22: What was the hardest bug to fix? 🐛[/b]

Last night we fixed a bug that removed one item and duplicated the other in your inventory. While this rare bug was already mentioned in the Lite/Demo version, we never figured out how to fix it. Until last night. We somehow experienced the same bug again and Ruben, our main play tester and bug hero, gathered the right info to reproduce it. Because of the frame-by-frame movie clip he made, we were able to see exactly what happened and we fixed the code just in time!

Ps. We cannot guarantee the game is completely bug-free, so please let us know on [url=https://www.discord.gg/rustylake]Discord[/url] or support [at] rustylake [dot] com if you experience anything while playing.

[b]@mc_puddlls’s: How many voices will there be in the game? Will it have more than one voice actor? 🗣️[/b]

Unfortunately, our best and beloved voice actor Bob Rafferty won’t be the only one voicing the characters this time around (although he would have loved to). Just like in The White Door, Bob Rafferty, Iris Muller and Sara Hill are our main voice actors, but this time we got help from several different voice actors to bring the right quality to the game. But then again, there are more characters in-game, so you might know who helped us out here.

[b]@PurpleMcgee: Will there ever be a reveal of why Rose left Laura? 🌹[/b]

Yes! But we cannot say too much about this yet.

[b]@reyyanbetul_akgul’s: Which languages will be in the new game? 🌎[/b]

Our amazing group of translators together with our localization manager, Luuk, made Underground Blossom available in 21 languages! Please double-check your store (mobile or PC) to see if your language is available. We hope to add more languages in the future, but it costs a lot of time and hard work (from both sides) to implement a language correctly, hence why it will take us time to implement more languages.

[b]@alr.saraa’s: Not about the development process but will you have a #laketober this year? 🎨[/b]

Yes! October would not exist without #Laketober. Our community managers Andreea, Damy and our mod team on Discord cannot wait to share the prompt list very soon! And yes it will be centred around Underground Blossom!

[b]@niohsen.shanjamali’s: What happened to the mammoth game?[/b]

We cannot go back that far in time just yet. Now it’s time to Blossom 🎟️ 🚇 🌸

We hope we answered your burning questions about Underground Blossom and other Rusty Lake topics, we did our best to get to as many of them as possible! Thank you for all your great questions, but now we need to once again retreat and prepare the final tweaks on the upcoming Underground Blossom metro! 
[i]
Underground Blosssom is a new adventure game by Rusty Lake and comes out tomorrow at 13:00 CEST / 04:00 PT. It’s a premium game and will cost around €/$ 4,99 on Steam (but with a 30% discount in the first week)! If you are not sure this is a game for you; please check out our demo: you can still download it here on the Steam or download try the Lite version on Mobile! [/i]

See you on Release Station tomorrow, September 27th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291850/Underground_Blossom/

notes.title: Underground Blossom Devlog 2 - Sound and Music
notes.notes:
[h3]Underground Blossom Devlog 2 - Sound and Music[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/9e9f36e0a72312bd979c6fc1b3c6543a282555f5.png[/img]
Hi everyone! 👋

We are back with a new devlog! Since the music and sound devlog we wrote for The Past Within was one of our most popular devlog to date, we are very excited to share more about this interesting process for Underground Blossom as well. From the start, we knew that Underground Blossom’s gameplay experience would depend heavily on its soundtrack and that we needed something beautiful (and different) to accompany you through Laura Vanderboom’s journey. Luckily we have a great team around us that was (and is) ready to help elevate the audio of our upcoming project to new heights.

[b]Music[/b]

It was back in May this year (2023) when Victor Butzelaar invited us to a studio session at one of Amsterdam's most iconic music places (Muziekgebouw aan ‘t IJ). After composing the main theme song on the piano a few months before, Victor was now eager to record the complete soundtrack for Underground Blossom in an official studio - a first in the Rusty Lake series. He was accompanied by Sebastiaan van Halsema, a very experienced cello player, and Arjan van Asselt, who helped record all the input in the best quality possible. It was a magnificent experience for us to hear the piano and cello working together. It felt like we were attending our own Rusty Lake concert!

[previewyoutube=CaybKiO0wKc;full][/previewyoutube]
That day Victor and his team recorded dozens of tracks for Underground Blossom and we couldn't wait to try them in-game. As expected, the recorded music fit the atmosphere of the game perfectly, so much so that almost all tracks ended up in the actual game. The combination of the piano and cello worked so well to enhance the (emotional) journey of Laura. Each station has its own vibe and feeling, all thanks to the diverse tracks created by Victor.

[i]Fun note:[/i] the way the in-game music works is a bit different than our previous games (except for The Past Within), here some music is only triggered in the case of a (special) event. Only then a piano/cello theme will start to play.

[b]Sound[/b]

After our first successful sound design collaboration for The Past Within, we couldn’t wait to work again with our amazing sound designers Jorick and Giliam from Driftwood Audio. The sound effects in our first co-op game truly elevated the experience and for Underground Blossom, we wanted to reach at least the same level of quality. This mixed in with the right (background) sound effects would be necessary to achieve the right atmosphere for a game that takes place mostly on metro station platforms. After months of hard work, we are happy to share that they delivered once again, and how! The game is filled with more than 240 unique sound effects and we are sure you will have fun with quite a few of them.

[url=https://www.instagram.com/reel/CxdIHoDMuly/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/7b30ef02f77f1b0852b001f5b87e7a2b1e325de1.png[/img]
[/url]
[b]Voiceover and extra effects[/b]

There are many characters to meet in Underground Blossom, some familiar faces, but also quite a few new ones. Bob Rafferty, our favourite man of many voices, is back! He even whispers this time. Iris Muller, whom you might remember from The White Door, is returning to voice Laura again. Andreea Bosgan, our very own community manager, takes the role of Young Laura to profess her need for candy. And we have some special guests like Hugo Bonaparte and Mike Wijdenbosch for some new characters. Next to all these voices, we have Remco Mikkers who adds his trumpet solos to the choir - yet another amazing addition to the overall sounds of Underground Blossom. 

[url=https://www.instagram.com/reel/CxdG1JcMkcO/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/03e4cb5fdd4716976e6fd3b8f10911089b895d4c.png[/img][/url]
At the moment of writing this we are still fine-tuning the audio of the game: adding/adjusting some final sound effects and voiceovers. It is always the final steps that make the game feel and sound perfect. We hope you enjoyed getting some insights on the music, sound and voiceovers that you can expect to experience very soon in the game. The release date is very close now.. we have to go… we hear a metro arriving... 

[b]Ps.[/b] Don’t forget to share your questions below for next week's Q&A session!

notes.title: Underground Blossom – Devlog 1 – A brief history
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/1244b06e36ca95c446a40ef62c6e4c4ad3d94c0b.png[/img]

After sharing insights on the development of The Past Within, we are very excited to return with a fresh devlog for Underground Blossom #UBDevlog. Today let’s dive into the history of the project but first, we would like to share a list of what we are working on now (with only 3 weeks left): 

[list]
[*] Finalising all the achievements: Every station will have its own secrets!
[*] Our amazing group of translators are finishing the translations: the game will be available in more than 21+ languages!
[*] We are adding the last sound effects and music: Stay tuned for more on that in the next devlog!
[*] Optimising the game performance: We don’t want you to experience any lag when a new train arrives.
[*] Adjusting the game based on all the feedback we received at Gamescom: Thank you to everyone who came by our booth!
[*] And most importantly: testing, testing, testing to make sure the stations are bug-free.
[/list]

These upcoming weeks will be crazy busy for us, but we are doing everything we can to ensure this train will arrive on the 27th on both PC and Mobile. A small reminder that a ticket to enter the train will cost around 4,99 $ / 4,99 € on Steam (with a special release discount during the first week)! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/6106d87820d40124dd864c57e1dee3ef4a376795.png[/img]
[i]One of the first sketches of a station in Underground Blossom[/i]

For this devlog we want to dive a bit into the history of this special project. We’ve already brainstormed about this concept for quite some years. Having a train station is an interesting location: new trains come by, new people arrive and, in a way, taking a train to the next station symbolizes a new chapter in someone’s life. Laura has been one of the main characters throughout the Rusty Lake series and since we have been quite secretive about big parts of her life, we thought matching this concept with Laura was a perfect fit.

We only had to wait for the right moment to start working on the first prototype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/c1623ea2af52daa9285a0269d3f8c69961143796.png[/img]
[i]First puzzle prototypes![/i]

These screenshots are from back around the time we started working on The Past Within. For quite some time we worked simultaneously on these two projects. If we got stuck on one project, we could continue with the other. With The Past Within we faced a lot of struggles to create our first co-op experience (feel free to check our previous devlogs). But also while the structure for Underground Blossom was laid out very quickly, telling Laura’s life throughout different stations was not as easy as we thought. So being able to switch between the projects in the beginning was very helpful for us in shaping both projects.

However, we soon realised that focusing on multiple projects at the same time is very difficult, especially with a project like The Past Within, where a lot more people are involved. Thus we decided to go for – some might argue- the riskier route, and focus on finalising The Past Within first. Luckily this decision had some benefits for Underground Blossom as well. The Past Within got us to step up our game with both the sound design (Jorick and Giliam from Driftwood Audio were excited to join) and music (Victor Butzelaar rented a studio this time). Since people enjoyed these improvements so much from The Past Within, we carried this level of attention to detail into the development of Underground Blossom.

After doing as many playtest sessions as we could, we also discovered that something was missing in the form of content. As a result, more stations/levels were added and the game became somewhat bigger than we initially planned. All in all, it was nice for this project to lay on the shelf for a while so it could blossom in its own way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/7daaeedff90ab8a0ba348da82d565967912c04ee.png[/img]
[i]The project needed time to blossom as well[/i]

This leads us to right now, the present, hardly able to believe that we are almost there again: a new release. And, luckily, within a year of our previous release. It means a lot that we can keep sharing these experiences with you all and we hope you have a bit more patience till this new journey arrives. 

Next week we will be back with some special behind-the-scenes material from our beloved composers Victor Butzelaar and Sebastiaan van Halsema and our amazing sound designers Jorick and Gilliam from Driftwood Audio.

Also, feel free to share some questions/ curiosities you might have regarding our project in the comments because the third and final devlog for Underground Blossom will be a Q&A!

Thank you for reading and your continued support,

Rusty Lake

notes.title: Underground Blossom 🚇 🌸 & Rusty Lake’s 8 Years Anniversary 🎂 🥳
notes.notes:
This week marks 8 years together as Rusty Lake! And, of course, we have to celebrate this incredible anniversary with a big announcement. 

But first: thank you all so much for your tremendous support that allowed us to reach this amazing milestone! We could never have imagined that we could sustain as a franchise over such a long period, and we owe a huge part of that to you - our amazing community! 

From the very first fanart of Cube Escape: Seasons sent to us, the support you showed by buying our first premium game: Rusty Lake Hotel, kickstarting our film-game crossover Cube Escape: Paradox, to allowing us to make something completely different like The White Door, or our first co-op experience: The Past Within - thank you for being such a huge and wonderful part of our journey over the past 8 years! 

Now time for the promised announcement! In celebration of our anniversary, it is time to officially reveal our upcoming project: Underground Blossom!

[previewyoutube=7I8eBrH7Azk;full][/previewyoutube]

Descend into the Rusty Lake Underground and travel through the life and memories of Laura Vanderboom!

Travel from station to station, each metro stop symbolising a piece of Laura's past and future. Solve various puzzles, find the correct metro to board and uncover one of Laura’s timelines, while simultaneously helping her make sense of her life and escape the corruption of her mind!

We understand that you all are very excited to play, so we made a 15-minute demo experience available for you to play. All aboard the Underground Blossom Demo - now live on Steam and soon Itch! Don’t forget to wishlist Underground Blossom to secure a ticket! 🎟️ 
And we're happy to share that Underground Blossom is part of Steam Puzzle Fest!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291850/Underground_Blossom/

The full experience will arrive later this year on PC (Windows and Mac) and Mobile (iOS & Android). We will share more about pricing at a later date!

[h3]More insights into the development of Underground Blossom:[/h3]

Many of you have read our Devlogs for The Past Within, where you could keep track of the development progress of our first 2-player project. But one thing we didn’t share in those blog posts, mainly due to not wanting to spoil the surprise just yet, was that we were also in the process of creating Underground Blossom. 

So whenever we had any spare time during the past year, we were simultaneously working on this project. At one point though, we had to pause our work on Underground Blossom to fully focus on The Past Within release (and its aftermath). Over the past few months, we were once again able to work full-time on Underground Blossom. And so far it has been going better than expected. Of course, we hoped for a quick release after The Past Within, but having the project on the back burner for a while made us realise we still had more improvements to make to the overall game: improving the structure, adding more levels and  giving the project an overall quality boost - things we were able to achieve over the past 4 months. We are again working with the amazing Sound Design team Jorick and Giliam to bring the same audio quality as in The Past Within. Victor will be working with a cellist to accompany his amazing new piano theme and deliver an extraordinary atmosphere to the game. So the project is shaping up really nicely, but we still need more time than we originally anticipated (spring 2023)... The coming two months will be filled with testing, improving the flow, achievements, adding a lot of extra stuff, translations and much more. So we are now aiming for a late Summer release. This means we still have some months of hard work ahead of us, but then we are confident we can deliver an amazing experience. Please stay tuned and make sure to leave your feedback on the demo on our [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Discord[/url] or the Steam discussions.

From now on you can expect a lot more updates on Underground Blossom. 

[h3]More celebration![/h3]

To celebrate our 8-year anniversary, we have prepared a few extra surprises over the course of this week, so we can better share the festivities with all of you!
To kickstart our anniversary week we of course just announced our upcoming title and the demo release of Underground Blossom.

Next up on the list, we’re happy to share that during this week all our premium games will have discounts! On Steam we are taking part in The Steam Puzzle Fest from today April 24th (7 pm CEST) till Monday, May 1st (7 pm CEST), [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/rustylake]where all our games are 50% OFF[/url]! 
 
We also have some exclusive, limited-edition goodies coming your way later this week, as well as some giveaways scattered here and there! Make sure to check our socials so you don’t miss out on all the festivities!

Once again thank you all for your continued support! Here’s to many more years to come at Rusty Lake, it's time to make some more memories!
